meta.source: WordPress 7.1 wp-admin/css/colors/_tokens.scss (WordPress Design System), as CSS variables. bin/generate-tokens.php writes assets/tokens.css from this file.

tokens.name: bp-color-background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind screens; WordPress gray-100.

tokens.name: bp-color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, menus, the sheet; text on it reads at every text token's ratio.

tokens.name: bp-color-surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate table rows, as WordPress's list tables.

tokens.name: bp-color-text
tokens.usage: Text and titles on background, surface and tints (16.7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: bp-color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, help and meta on surface (6.6:1) and background (5.8:1).

tokens.name: bp-color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface only (4.6:1); fails on background.

tokens.name: bp-color-divider
tokens.usage: Card outlines and dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: bp-color-border-control
tokens.usage: Field, dropdown and switch-off borders (3.0:1 on surface).

tokens.name: bp-color-action
tokens.usage: Primary button, links, current tab, focused field (5.6:1 on surface). In wp-admin, the user's admin colour.

tokens.name: bp-color-action-hover
tokens.usage: Action on hover; text on action-tint (6.1:1).

tokens.name: bp-color-action-tint
tokens.usage: Tint behind action-coloured content: icon tiles, filter chips, info notices.

tokens.name: bp-color-on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill (5.6:1).

tokens.name: bp-color-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring of links and buttons (5.1:1 on surface).

tokens.name: bp-color-backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind a modal sheet or dialog.

tokens.name: bp-tone-success-mark
tokens.usage: Success dot or icon beside a word; never text (2.5:1).

tokens.name: bp-tone-success-text
tokens.usage: Success text and active switches (6.3:1).

tokens.name: bp-tone-success-bg
tokens.usage: Success notice and badge ground.

tokens.name: bp-tone-warning-mark
tokens.usage: Warning dot beside a word; never text or a lone icon (1.8:1).

tokens.name: bp-tone-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (4.8:1).

tokens.name: bp-tone-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning notice and banner ground.

tokens.name: bp-tone-danger-mark
tokens.usage: Error icon and dot (5.7:1).

tokens.name: bp-tone-danger-text
tokens.usage: Error text (5.7:1).

tokens.name: bp-tone-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error notice ground.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen-Sans, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen-Sans, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

styles.name: text-s
styles.sample: Attribué au club par la fédération.
styles.usage: Help, meta, field labels in toolbars.

styles.name: text-m
styles.usage: Body, fields, buttons; WordPress's admin size.

tokens.name: bp-text-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, badges.

tokens.name: bp-text-s
tokens.usage: Help, meta, toolbar labels.

tokens.name: bp-text-m
tokens.usage: Body, fields, buttons.

tokens.name: bp-text-l
tokens.usage: Section headings.

tokens.name: bp-text-body
tokens.usage: Field values and running text on a public page: 16px, so phones do not zoom into a field.

tokens.name: bp-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its word; label to its field.

tokens.name: bp-space-2
tokens.usage: Between controls, chips, buttons.

tokens.name: bp-space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps in a toolbar; compact padding; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: bp-space-4
tokens.usage: Between a screen's parts; padding of rows and the sheet.

tokens.name: bp-space-5
tokens.usage: Header padding of a section.

tokens.name: bp-space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; between sections.

tokens.name: bp-space-8
tokens.usage: Before a locked page's text; empty states.

tokens.name: bp-space-12
tokens.usage: Logo and avatar tiles.

tokens.name: bp-control-height
tokens.usage: Fields, dropdowns and buttons; WordPress 7's default.

tokens.name: bp-control-height-compact
tokens.usage: Fields and dropdowns in a toolbar; menu items.

tokens.name: bp-control-height-touch
tokens.usage: Fields and buttons on a public page: 48px, the usual minimum target for a finger.

tokens.name: bp-radius-s
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: bp-radius-m
tokens.usage: Fields, dropdowns, notices, menu items.

tokens.name: bp-radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, tiles, the sheet.

tokens.name: bp-radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, switches, dots.

tokens.name: bp-shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: bp-shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The phone sheet and dialogs; WordPress elevation-l.

tokens.name: bp-shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: A switch's thumb.

tokens.name: bp-duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and focus changes, a chevron turning.

tokens.name: bp-duration-base
tokens.usage: A switch, a fade, a colour change.

tokens.name: bp-duration-slow
tokens.usage: Something opening: a row's detail, a pop.

tokens.name: bp-ease-out
tokens.usage: Every transition, unless it springs.

tokens.name: bp-ease-spring
tokens.usage: A switch's thumb, a slight overshoot.
